content: Semantics of attribute ClientComSpec . transformation- ComSpecProps The attribute ClientComSpec . transformationComSpecProps shall be used to configure PortPrototype -specific properties for data transforma- tion in case of Client/Server inter-ECU communication for the reception of the server’s response.
